function.name: edit
function.description: Exact old_string -> new_string replacement in one existing file. The file must have been read (via the read tool) since its last change, and old_string must occur exactly once unless replace_all=true — ambiguity is an error, never a guess. Use write for creating new files; edit only modifies existing ones.

path.description: Path to the file to modify

old_string.description: Exact text to find (must be non-empty and unique unless replace_all)

new_string.description: Replacement text (empty string deletes the span)

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring exactly one
